name: ISO/IEC 42001: management-system readiness (draft)
description: Project-scoped preparation records for an AI management system: scope, responsibilities, risk treatment and improvement. Based only on the public ISO overview; no clause or Annex A mapping.
limitations: This is a GovWeave preparation checklist informed by the public overview, not the licensed standard, a clause-level assessment, an Annex A mapping or certification.
The current evaluation scope is a product and its linked applications; it does not assess an entire organization or certify its AI management system.
Availability facts are operator-supplied references. The evaluator does not read documents, authenticate their authors or establish adequacy; human review remains unknown.
The 30-day evidence freshness interval is a local assurance choice, not an ISO requirement. Obtain licensed materials and qualified review for detailed conformity assessment.
